subject: Sender's own first-notice and field-inspection language, claim CLM-2026-3105 (FNOL-2026-3105), loss of 2026-07-19
source: Quoted verbatim from the disclosed records of the sender's adjudication evidence pack. Quotations are usable only after the pack has verified; verify first.
fnolDescription: Stovetop fire spread to the surrounding cabinetry before being extinguished by the fire department. Significant smoke damage throughout the ground floor. No injuries reported. Family has relocated to temporary accommodation; the property is not currently habitable.

fieldInspection.findings: Burn and char patterns identify the origin as a single cooking-fire event at the stovetop, with rapid spread to adjacent cabinetry — consistent with the fire department's incident report. No accelerant traces, no evidence of code violations, wiring intact. Smoke residue is distributed through the ground-floor rooms; water staining is limited to the suppression response. Findings are consistent with a sudden, accidental fire loss.

deskNote: The adjudication record on which the sender's payment rests describes a cooking-fire origin at the stovetop and records the wiring as intact, with no evidence of code violations. Any attribution to electrical work post-dates the payment and rests on an examination the sender commissioned itself. The seam between the record and the demand's theory is the desk's first question.
